review_text: Green Coffee is honestly one of my favorite spots to hang out or get some work done. The place is cozy and relaxing, and the location along Diversion Road makes it feel like a nice escape from the busy city. I especially love the alfresco area—the greenery and outdoor setting make it such a pleasant place to sit, whether you’re working remotely or catching up with friends. The coffee is consistently good, and the pastries are absolutely divine. It’s the kind of place where you can easily spend hours enjoying the atmosphere, a good cup of coffee, and great food. The only downside during my visits has been the service. The staff didn’t come across as very friendly or welcoming, which is a bit disappointing considering how wonderful the place itself is. A warmer and more attentive approach from the team would really elevate the whole experience. Overall, still a great café for the ambiance, coffee, and pastries—I just hope the customer service improves to match how amazing the place is. ☕🌿

The place is spacious, clean, with wifi available & polite staff! Parking is not a problem. The building is almost surrounded with parking spaces. No issues with insects or lizards unless you occupy a table outside the building, as what I heard from the others.🙄 It is just normal for open spaces, to encounter things like that. 🤔😃 There are plenty of tables outside the building. So, just stay inside the building if you are afraid of lizards or insects. I think it is seldom. I enjoy my coffee and time in this place while waiting for my XYL.😃😄

I went to Green Coffee Diversion Road at 3:22 AM, well before their advertised closing time of 4:00 AM. As soon as we arrived, the staff suddenly turned off the lights to make us leave and told us they were already closed. This was very disappointing because they clearly advertise that they are open until 4 AM. The staff seemed to already be cleaning the place and looked unwilling to make the drinks we ordered, almost like they just didn’t want to serve customers anymore. The staff was rude and unaccommodating, and there was no effort to honor their posted business hours. If you advertise that you close at 4 AM, customers should still be able to order at 3:22 AM. Very poor customer service and a frustrating experience. I hope management addresses this because it reflects badly on the establishment.

Loved how the place was so spacious and bright, great for meetings and gatherings. Unfortunately, coffee was too sweet and food choices were limited to pastries. Hope they would expand their menu to cater to more varied customers.

The staffs are ok, couldnt have been better if they can greet you more warmer 😊 All in all, a nice coffee to conduct business, meeting friends and substitute for overcrowd coffee places. The staff was cleaning beside me nonstop — every few seconds — and even kept moving the chair near me just to make noise. It honestly felt intentional. This was the third time, and it’ll be my last. The desserts at this coffee shop are fantastic, and the place is very spacious, which is a big plus. One standout feature is the alfresco area—something rare for coffee shops in Davao City. I've visited multiple times this year because I genuinely enjoy the ambiance and offerings. However, the customer service consistently leaves much to be desired, particularly with the cashier. Every single time I've been here, the cashier has been grumpy, rude, and unhelpful. For example, when I asked for a recommendation, she simply listed what was available without offering any real guidance. During another visit, I ordered a flat white, and she sarcastically remarked, "You're aware it's only one size, right?" It felt unnecessarily dismissive. Interactions with other staff haven’t been much better. When I asked for an extra straw, a staff member just dropped it on the counter without a word, making it seem like they actively dislike engaging with customers. I’ve noticed many of the negative reviews here also mention rude staff, especially the cashier. I truly hope management addresses this issue because it’s a significant drawback to an otherwise great coffee shop. Good customer service is essential, and this place could be so much better if the staff were friendlier and more accommodating.

I've been to Green Coffee Diversion, Davao City multiple times, especially on days when working from home gets a little too quiet or boring — and I have to say, they picked such a great location! The ambiance is beautiful and cozy, making it a perfect spot to relax or get some work done. That said, I do hope they consider expanding their food menu. While I enjoy their drinks and sweets, it would be nice to have more savory options like pasta or light meals. Eating sweets all the time can get a bit repetitive. Still, it's definitely one of my go-to spots in the city. Looking forward to my next visit — hopefully with some new food choices on the menu!

Green Coffee's newest branch on Diversion Road is a welcome addition to Davao City's bustling coffee scene. The spacious, modern interior is bathed in natural light, creating an inviting atmosphere for both work and relaxation. The sleek design, comfortable seating, and ample charging stations make it an ideal spot for students and professionals alike. Their extensive menu offers a wide variety of coffee drinks, from classic brewed coffee to innovative concoctions. The baristas are skilled and knowledgeable, ensuring a perfectly crafted cup every time. Don't miss their signature Green Coffee Freeze, a refreshing blend of coffee, milk, and ice cream. For those seeking a caffeine-free option, their selection of teas and fruit smoothies are equally satisfying. Beyond beverages, Green Coffee also serves a delectable array of pastries and light meals. The croissants are flaky and buttery, while the cakes are both beautiful and delicious. The sandwiches and salads are fresh and flavorful, making them perfect for a quick lunch or afternoon snack. Whether you're looking for a place to study, catch up with friends, or simply enjoy a great cup of coffee, Green Coffee Diversion Road is sure to impress. The combination of excellent coffee, delicious food, and inviting ambiance makes it a must-visit destination for any coffee lover in Davao City.

I ordered a regular hot matcha latte for takeout at Green Coffee on Diversion Road. I paid and was informed that there would be no receipt, so I set it aside. After waiting for 30 minutes without hearing my name called, I asked the barista about my order. They simply said it would be prepared soon. Without a receipt, I was confused and concerned. After waiting a total of 45 minutes, I asked again, and the barista seemed bewildered—they hadn't even started making my drink. I paid for it, waited all that time, and it was never made. This is incredibly frustrating, especially since I ordered for takeout and my time was completely wasted waiting. As an avid fan of your coffee, this experience has been extremely disappointing and frustrating. I can't believe I had to wait that long only to find out my drink wasn't even in the process of being made.

If you’re planning to bring your laptop, I recommend bringing your own extension cord. Several of the power outlets were either loose or not working, and some wouldn’t securely fit my UGreen charger, which made charging my laptop frustrating.
